question.text: Kavitha, a distributor, is reviewing an AIF's qualified audit opinions, latest audit report, internal/governance audit functions, and noted control weaknesses. This finding is MOST relevant to which DD area?

answer.text: Operational due diligence and audit/internal-control assessment

explanation.text: The Logic: Annexure 8.1 of the workbook lists qualified audit opinions, the latest audit report, accounting/internal/governance audit functions, and identified control weaknesses among the items investors should review as part of operational due diligence. The Trap: Audit and internal-control items may indirectly affect reported performance, but the primary DD category is operational assessment. Note: Annexure 8.1 sits inside the workbook's operational DD checklist, so any item it names — including audit opinions and internal-control weaknesses — falls under operational due diligence.
